nodes.summary: The asymmetric TSP decision problem accepts a bitstring $x$ when $x$ decodes, under the canonical bitstring encoding of asymmetric TSP instances, to an instance $(n, w, B)$ that is well formed and feasible, and rejects $x$ otherwise; in particular it rejects every bitstring that does not decode to an instance.
nodes.title: The asymmetric traveling salesperson decision problem

nodes.summary: An asymmetric TSP instance $(n, w, B)$ is feasible when there is a list $t$ of natural numbers with no repeated entries, of length $n$ and containing every $v < n$ (so $t$ lists the cities $0, \dots, n - 1$ in some order), whose tour length under $w$ is at most $B$.
nodes.title: Feasible asymmetric TSP instances

nodes.summary: An instance of the asymmetric traveling salesperson problem is a triple $(n, w, B)$ consisting of a natural number $n$ (the number of cities), a weight matrix $w$ given as a list of rows, each row a list of natural numbers, and a natural number $B$ (the bound).
nodes.title: Asymmetric TSP instances

nodes.summary: The asymmetric traveling salesperson decision problem belongs to NP, and every decision problem in NP reduces to it by a polynomial-time many-one reduction.
nodes.title: TRAVELING SALESPERSON (ASYMMETRIC) is NP-complete

nodes.summary: Let $w$ be a weight matrix, given as a list of rows of natural numbers, and let $t = (t_0, \dots, t_{L-1})$ be a list of natural numbers. The length of the tour $t$ under $w$ is $\sum_{j=0}^{L-1} w_{t_j, t_{(j+1) \bmod L}}$, the sum of the weights along the closed walk including the return edge from $t_{L-1}$ to $t_0$, where $w_{a,b}$ denotes the entry in row $a$ and column $b$ of $w$, taken to be $0$ when that…
nodes.title: Length of a tour in the asymmetric TSP

nodes.summary: An asymmetric TSP instance $(n, w, B)$, with $n$ the number of cities, $w$ the weight matrix and $B$ the bound, is well formed when $n > 0$, $w$ has exactly $n$ rows, every row of $w$ has length $n$, and the diagonal entry $w_{a,a}$ in row $a$ and column $a$ is $0$ for every $a < n$.
nodes.title: Well-formed asymmetric TSP instances
